knowledge_base.answer: No: copying all 287 trades with $10000 of fake money ended at 8806.02, a -11.94% loss, while buying and holding the S&P 500 (SPY) gained 19.64%. The worst drop along the way was -20.4%, and part of the result rests on guesses, since exits were assumed for 128 day trades and $1000 was assumed on 199 entries with no share count. The course itself says you don't have to take every trade [LPP-AVOID-2], so copying everything isn't what it teaches, and this test can't say whether picking only some trades would have done better. Not advice.
